A migration reviewer cannot prove which correction-map and owner-resolution semantics generated the exact registry bytes, and accepting would silently reinterpret frozen provenance.

RESTORE-OWNER-002 expects recovery of the same plan/temp/credential or exposure of abort through status, and RESTORE-OWNER-003 expects recovery or exact abort. Those alternatives do not choose one request after restart, one response, or one exhaustive post-state.

RESTORE-OWNER-008 combines absent, linked, unsafe, identity-mismatched, content-mismatched, protection-mismatched, and owner-mismatched locator states in one leaf even though absence and unsafe preservation have different physical disposition evidence.
